topics.description: The federal government has deferred $91 million in Medicaid funding to Minnesota due to fraud concerns. This is part of an ongoing investigation into potential fraud in the state's Medicaid program.
topics.reason: New developments in Minnesota Medicaid funding fraud investigation

topics.description: The Justice Department has launched an investigation into 36 Illinois public school districts over their gender curriculum. This investigation is ongoing and may lead to further action.
topics.reason: Justice Department investigation into Illinois public school districts
